title: CVE-2026-137416 — sgl-project SpecForge Draft Embedding Loader base.py Eagle3DraftModel.load_embedding path traversal
summary: Affected: sgl-project SpecForge A weakness has been identified in sgl-project SpecForge 0.2.0. This impacts the function Eagle3DraftModel.load_embedding of the file specforge/modeling/draft/base.py of the component Draft Embedding Loader. Executing a manipulation can lead to path traversal. The attack can only be executed locally. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This patch is called d8a0d78e071199563ef19d9171052096dec89f71. It is advisable to implement a patch to correct this issue.

title: CVE-2026-137415 — Tencent RapidJSON writer.h WriteString integer overflow
summary: Affected: Tencent RapidJSON A security flaw has been discovered in Tencent RapidJSON up to 1.1.0. This affects the function Writer::WriteString in the library include/rapidjson/writer.h. Performing a manipulation of the argument length results in integer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The patch is named 297637bc0a0f00dc504dbc1a47ebdaa577f8ae19. To fix this issue, it is recommended to deploy a patch.

title: CVE-2026-137414 — itsourcecode Event Management System view_event.php sql injection
summary: Affected: itsourcecode Event Management System A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file view_event.php. Such manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

title: CVE-2026-137412 — projectworlds Online Jewellery Shopping System Advanced Search dashbord_model.php Dashbord_model.searchAdvance sql inje…
summary: Affected: projectworlds Online Jewellery Shopping System A vulnerability was determined in projectworlds Online Jewellery Shopping System 1.0. The affected element is the function Dashbord_model.searchAdvance of the file /jewllary-shop/application/models/dashbord_model.php of the component Advanced Search. This manipulation of the argument from/to causes sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

title: CVE-2026-126984 — Pulp_python: pulp_python: pull-through caching fetches a client-supplied url with the remote's credentials
summary: Affected: pulp_python A **server-side request forgery** flaw has been found in the get_remote_artifact_url() function in pulp_python/app/models.py of the pull-through caching feature in the **pulp_python** package. The function uses the redirect query parameter from the client request as the URL to download. A network attacker or user who can reach the content app of a Python distribution that has a remote can choose that URL. The content app downloads it and returns the response. When the remote has a username and password, the download sends those credentials to the host in the URL. When the remote policy is immediate, the default, or on_demand, the file is saved into the distribution's repository and later clients are served that file. The project name and version come from the file, and the filename comes from the request path. A filename the repository already stores is served from the stored file.

title: CVE-2026-107912 — Io.quarkus/quarkus-vertx-http: quarkus-vertx-http: authorization bypass in management interface via path concatenation…
summary: Affected: Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.27.6.SP3, Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.33.4.SP3, Red Hat Exploit Intelligence, Red Hat OpenShift Serverless, Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4 for Quarkus 3, Red Hat build of Apicurio Registry 3, Red Hat build of Debezium 3, Red Hat Build of Keycloak, Red Hat Fuse 7, Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI) and 1 more A flaw was found in the management interface of the Quarkus framework, specifically within the quarkus-vertx-http component. The issue occurs when the framework incorrectly combines the management root path with specific permission rules, leading to a situation where security policies are applied to the wrong internal paths. As a result, an attacker can bypass intended authorization checks and gain unauthorized access to sensitive management endpoints.

title: CVE-2024-3727 — Containers/image: digest type does not guarantee valid type
summary: Affected: image, Red Hat OADP-1.3-RHEL-9, Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security 4.4, Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security 4.5, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9, Red Hat Migration Toolkit for Containers 1.8, Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.13, Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.14, Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 4.15 and 22 more A flaw was found in the github.com/containers/image library. This flaw allows attackers to trigger unexpected authenticated registry accesses on behalf of a victim user, causing resource exhaustion, local path traversal, and other attacks.

title: CVE-2024-1300 — Io.vertx:vertx-core: memory leak when a tcp server is configured with tls and sni support
summary: Affected: io.vertx:vertx-core, Red Hat CEQ 3.2, Red Hat Cryostat 2 on RHEL 8, Red Hat Migration Toolkit for Runtimes 1 on RHEL 8, Red Hat MTA-6.2-RHEL-9, Red Hat AMQ Streams 2.7.0, Red Hat build of Apache Camel 4.4.1 for Spring Boot 3.2, Red Hat build of Quarkus 3.2.11.Final, Red Hat RHINT Service Registry 2.5.11 GA, Red Hat A-MQ Clients 2 and 15 more A vulnerability in the Eclipse Vert.x toolkit causes a memory leak in TCP servers configured with TLS and SNI support. When processing an unknown SNI server name assigned the default certificate instead of a mapped certificate, the SSL context is erroneously cached in the server name map, leading to memory exhaustion. This flaw allows attackers to send TLS client hello messages with fake server names, triggering a JVM out-of-memory error.

title: CVE-2024-1249 — Keycloak: org.keycloak.protocol.oidc: unvalidated cross-origin messages in checkloginiframe leads to ddos
summary: Affected: keycloak, Red Hat AMQ Broker 7, Red Hat build of Keycloak 22, Red Hat build of Keycloak 22.0.10, Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.6 for RHEL 7, Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.6 for RHEL 8, Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.6 for RHEL 9, Red Hat RHEL-8 based Middleware Containers, Red Hat RHOSS-1.33-RHEL-8, Red Hat RHSSO 7.6.8 and 14 more A flaw was found in Keycloak's OIDC component in the "checkLoginIframe," which allows unvalidated cross-origin messages. This flaw allows attackers to coordinate and send millions of requests in seconds using simple code, significantly impacting the application's availability without proper origin validation for incoming messages.

title: CVE-2024-1151 — Kernel: stack overflow problem in open vswitch kernel module leading to dos
summary: Affected: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.2 Extended Update Support, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 A vulnerability was reported in the Open vSwitch sub-component in the Linux Kernel. The flaw occurs when a recursive operation of code push recursively calls into the code block. The OVS module does not validate the stack depth, pushing too many frames and causing a stack overflow. As a result, this can lead to a crash or other related issues.
